strongestcues.groupA: More angular cheek and jaw contours, pronounced brow ridges, narrower mouths, and relatively deep-set eyes.
strongestcues.groupB: Generally fuller cheeks, softer jaw transitions, less prominent brows, and rounder nose tips.

remainingheadwearimpact: Moderate: caps and veils still conceal hairlines and parts of the temples. Similar coverings could bias grouping, although facial contours and features were the primary cues. Visible hair color and texture remain additional potential confounds.
